## Scope

Describe the change and the QMS workflow, addon, document, or deployment area it affects.

## Validation

List the checks run locally or in GitHub Actions. Include any Odoo regression suite when relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is described clearly.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where the behavior changed.
- [ ] Regression suite passes, or any limitation is documented.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords, or private keys are committed.
- [ ] No customer data, backups, filestore content, or attachments are committed.
- [ ] No licensed standard publications or copied external-standard text are committed.
- [ ] Migration impact was reviewed.
- [ ] Security and multi-company impact were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.

## Release Notes

Note any user-visible change, migration step, or operational follow-up. Use `None` for internal-only changes.
